name: Les Docks des Petroles d'Ambes -SA
summary: Les Docks des Pétroles d'Ambès SA engages in the reception, storage, and shipping of petroleum products in France. It offers products through two pipelines. The company was founded in 1930 and is based in Carbon-Blanc, France. Les Docks des Pétroles d'Ambès SA is a subsidiary of Entrepots Petroliers Regionnaux.
